Week 5 · Day 1 · Discover the Situation

Shopping for food

Every week, you buy food for your family. Today you will look at how people ask for food at a shop.

Useful words for this situation.

Tap a card to see what each word means.

See how people use this English.

Read how the customer talks to the shop assistant.

Or tap a speaker icon below to hear one line.

CustomerExcuse me, I need some rice.
AssistantYes, of course.
CustomerDo you have any milk?
AssistantYes, we do.
CustomerWhere can I find the eggs?
AssistantThey are next to the milk.
CustomerI'd like two bottles of water, please.
AssistantHere you are.
CustomerHow much is the bread?
AssistantOne moment, please.
CustomerI also need some fruit.
AssistantNo problem.

What is happening?

Look at the scene again and think about it. There are no wrong answers — tap "Show me" if you want help.

Who is in the scene?

Two women: a customer and a shop assistant.

Where are they?

In a food shop, near the shelves.

What is the customer doing?

She is buying food for her family, using her shopping list.
